Resource pack builds of Fresh Moves Fix, a fork of [Fresh Moves](https://github.com/IthanMendoza/Fresh-Moves) by IthanMendoza.

**Which file?**

- `Fresh-Moves-Fix.zip` - works for every version from 1.20 to 26.3 (recommended)
- `Fresh-Moves-Fix-mc<version>.zip` - the same pack labelled for one Minecraft version

**Required mods:** the latest [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) and [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures).

These builds have not been tested in-game. On Minecraft 1.21.5 and newer the cape and elytra animations may not work correctly.

**New in 3.1-fix3:** the install notes inside the zips name the EMF version needed on Minecraft 26.x (26.1 - 26.1.2: EMF 3.3.2 or newer; 26.3: EMF 3.3.6 or newer). The pack files themselves are unchanged.

**New in 3.1-fix2:** a wave emote. Stand still, sneak and look straight up, and the right arm waves.
